purpose: Actual-output diagnostic and GT-dependent reward study, no model training or deployable reranker
split: sha256(video_path) parity; videos do not cross splits
selected_rows: First eligible groups in saved file per split, each has 8 candidates and 3<=duration<=3600
main_variant: occupancy/event-balanced support mixture alpha=0.5, same GT duration normalization
selection: Maximum GT-dependent reward, first candidate breaks exact ties
metrics: Merged positive finite intervals, maximum-cardinality one-to-one IoU>=0.5 matching
boundary: Train-source diagnostic splits only; model SFT may have seen both; not independent model generalization
